pro_course_detail.title: Professional & Academic English Communication Skills
pro_course_detail.description:
You will be surprised how many times my English communication skills have saved me from embarassing situations!
This course helps you improve your professional communication in English for successful business interactions. You will learn how to write emails, speak at meetings and interviews, give presentations, and network online. In the second part of the course, you will understand the tips and tricks to establish a strong & charismatic personal presence. We will discuss salesman techniques and "pitch" fluency mastering in depth. When you complete this part of the course, you will be able to change how you speak English,i mprove your pronunciation and fluency, increase your English vocabulary, identify how culture influences your speech, use culture to help you speak correctly, demonstrate the best body language for different cultural settings, and know statements, questions and responses for different settings and situations. At the end of the course, I will teach how to have a strong online presence and show you proof of how companies are reaching out to me to sign e-learning contracts with me. I will teach you how to write a summary about yourself & write a tweet to get a job. The last part of this course will be dedicated to advanced assessment of cultural situations, identify ways to improve communication and decrease misunderstanding. You will complete this capstone part by establishing long term communication strategies for building lasting work/business relationships.

For a better deal, I advice you to buy the total packages:
- First and second part of the course : 2 hours per week for 10 weeks.
- Last two parts of the course : 3 hours per week for 8 weeks.

You may cancel your packages at anytime.

pro_course_detail.title: Academic English Writing

You will learn to conduct advanced academic research and to express your ideas clearly in an academic format. The first month course will be an English grammar review for good writing and this will turn up as very useful in the future.  After completing this course, you will be able to: - create effective thesis statements for your essays - plan and write compare/contrast, cause/effect, and argument essays. In the last parts, we will learn advanced writing by raising the level of academic writing and academic research. The final part which is a projet based course project lets you apply everything you’ve learned and gives you the practice you need for college classes by having you write a research paper.

pro_course_detail.title: English basics for beginners and intermediates
pro_course_detail.description: In my lessons, students can expect to improve their speaking, listening, reading, and writing skills in an engaging and interactive way. Whether you are a beginner looking to build a strong foundation in English or a low -intermediate learner aiming for fluency and accuracy, my lessons are tailored to meet your needs. Instead of following a single textbook, I use a variety of authentic materials , including articles, videos, conversation exercises, and customized worksheets, to create a dynamic and effective learning experience. My approach is communicative and practical, focusing on real-life conversations, role-plays, grammar practice, and vocabulary building  to help students gain confidence and improve naturally. Beginners will focus on  basic communication skills, pronunciation, and essential vocabulary, while low-intermediate learners will work on fluency, advanced grammar, and natural expressions . I also provide listening activities, reading tasks, and structured exercises  to ensure a well-rounded learning journey. Each lesson is personalized to help you achieve your goals in a fun and supportive environment.

С обзиром да ми је ово матерњи језик, радо ћу Вам понудити лекције овог типа. 
Вјерујем да ћете се на мојим часовима осјећати подржано и да ће разговор са мном бити мотивишућ и занимљив.

pro_course_detail.title: Serbian Grammar, Reading and Writing- часови граматике на српском
pro_course_detail.description: Ако постоје недоумице око било којих граматичких цјелина у српском језику, радо ћу Вам изаћи у сусрет и помоћи да савладате дата језичка правила.
